inventRecord.mathematicalFormAscii: Δx_1^struct(τ_t) = θ · tanh(e_{t-1}^log / (α · x_3(τ_{t-1}))) · x_3(τ_{t-1}) · Δτ_t

assumptionsEn: Strictly causal filtration F_{t-1}: all state inputs X(τ_{t-1}) and innovation residuals e_{t-1} are realized prior to bar t.
Bounded saturating nonlinearity tanh(·) prevents fat-tailed liquidity sweeps from causing exponential forecast divergence.
Log-return increment scales homogeneously with local volatility x_3(τ_{t-1}) and information clock step Δτ_t.
assumptionsFa: فیلتراسیون کاملاً علی F_{t-1}: تمامی متغیرهای حالت X(τ_{t-1}) و پسماند e_{t-1} پیش از کندل t محقق شده‌اند.
غیرخطی اشباع‌شونده tanh(·) از واگرایی نمایی پیش‌بینی در برابر شوک‌های دنباله‌پهن جلوگیری می‌کند.
تغییر لگاریتم قیمت به صورت همگن با نوسان محلی x_3 و گام ساعت اطلاعاتی Δτ_t مقیاس می‌شود.

identifiabilityCheck.detailsEn: 2-parameter structural form (θ, α) calibrated over N_fit=31 causal bars with regularized design condition number κ=1.68.

inventRecord.expectedDirectionOfEffectEn: Reduce RESIDUAL_SERIAL_AUTOCORRELATION on out-of-sample evaluation bars while preserving positive-definite 6x6 state covariance.

falsifiablePredictions.statementEn: Out-of-sample 1-step RMSE must be less than or equal to the unmodified incumbent Yellow-Line RMSE on matched evaluation bars.
Target diagnostic statistic (RESIDUAL_SERIAL_AUTOCORRELATION) must decrease in magnitude on the out-of-sample window.

disconfirmationFailureConditionsEn: Disconfirmed if out-of-sample RMSE exceeds Incumbent Yellow-Line RMSE by > 1.0% on matched timestamps.
Disconfirmed if any technical check (dimensional homogeneity, parameter bounds, covariance PSD, prefix-invariance) fails.
Disconfirmed if out-of-sample to in-sample RMSE ratio exceeds 2.20 (severe overfitting).
